description: The bar chart, Figure 9, illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations by tag, comparing the performance of different models. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as "case", "gender", "number tag", and "tense", while the vertical axis is labeled "effect" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, marked at intervals of 5. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group corresponding to a category on the horizontal axis and containing six bars representing different models, distinguished by their colors as indicated in the legend: mBERT-L2 (blue), XLM-L2 (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (green), XLM-R2 (dark green), mBERT-B2 (pink), and XLM-B2 (red). For the "case" category, the bars have approximate values ranging from 2 to 12, with mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2 having the highest values. The "gender", "number tag", and "tense" categories have bars with much lower values, generally below 5. Error bars are present for each bar, indicating the standard deviation. The bars within each group are not sorted in a specific order, but the categories on the horizontal axis are presented in a fixed order. No bars are visually emphasized.
